main_text.p: Imperium conftituit & Schingvi Khan, i e. Rex Regum appellatus fuit. A quo tempore universa Scythia Tartaria; Scythæ Tartari, sive, ut vulgo loquuntur, Tatari vocati fuerunt. Cujus nominis occasio inde fluxit, quod in illa expeditione Schingvis Khanica Tartari, qui fuerunt tribus sive Horda Scytharum, semper præmitterentur, adeoque sparsa adventus eorum fama, cum populus passim inclamaret Tartaros advenitare[?], nomen illud paulatim universo exercitui, mox toti genti, fuit impositū; ut quicunque obedirent Schingvi Khano, sive Imperatori Schytarum, Tartari dicerentur.
main_text.head: Imperium Tartaricum divisum fuit in varia regna.
Explicatio 1.
main_text.p: (*) Divisio.Schingvis Khan paulo ante obitum suum inter filios suos univer-sum

page.notes: The left marginal note "(*) Divisio." carries a mark "(*)" whose reference mark is not visible in the text block; it is placed beside the heading line where it stands. The word "advenitare" is doubtful (the scan is blurred) and is marked [?]. The catchword "fum" at the lower right is partly cut off and marked [?]. The paragraph beginning "Schingvis Khan" is a continuation of the Explicatio, and the page ends at the foot of the column with the catchword. The right edge of the neighbouring page shows fragments of text, which were omitted.
